Subject: Proposal & SOW for EdgeAI EU pilot

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the conversation this week. Attached is the SOW for the 3-month pilot in our EU region and the standard Redwood MSA link. Key points: EU-only hosting (Frankfurt), 3-node cluster for the pilot, expected throughput ~10 req/s, and the onboarding schedule (kickoff next Mon).

Hi Rafael — thanks for the SOW. Legal returned a redline with three non-standard asks they need for procurement sign-off:

- Data residency guarantee: all processed and stored data must remain in EU jurisdiction (Frankfurt) with contractual restriction on cross-border egress.
- Audit rights: EdgeAI requests the ability to perform an on-site inspection of systems and personnel twice during the pilot and have access to raw logs.
- Commercial: we need a 35% pilot discount on list to justify the integration work.

I’ve attached the redline (EdgeAI_Redlines_v3.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept these or propose an alternative? Timing is tight — procurement needs final terms by COB Thursday to align with our internal pilot budget.

Best,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 15:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeAI redlines — need deal desk + legal guidance + exec signoff for exceptions

Rafael — quick legal assessment below. I’ve also attached a short approval request template (MA-Exec-Approval-Request.docx) you can use when escalating.

1) Data residency: Acceptable. We can contractually require hosting and storage to be in an EU region (Frankfurt). We must ensure encryption keys are also EU-restricted or explicitly documented if KMS is outside EU. Ops can implement a region-only routing policy for this pilot.

2) Audit rights: On-site inspections + raw log access is a material risk. Our standard approach: provide SOC2 Type II report and redacted log extracts on request. Proposed compromise for pilot: allow one remote/virtual audit (screen-shared session) + periodic automated log exports limited to metadata and security telemetry (no raw user payloads). Any on-site access must be negotiated separately and requires 60 days' notice, an NDA addendum, and approval from Exec (Laura). No source code, no access to customer account credentials. Also cap audit frequency to once per 12 months for production; for pilot allow 1 session during the pilot.

3) Discount: Pricing team says discount >20% requires VP commercial approval. Given this is a short pilot and strategic reference, we can consider up to 25% one-time pilot discount if Legal holds to the restricted audit scope and data deletion clause. Any discount beyond that needs CFO or CRO sign-off.

Next steps: Rafael, if you can get Sophie to accept the constrained audit language and confirm EU KMS requirements, I recommend we escalate to Laura for a final exec exception on the discount. Add the approval doc (I attached) and I’ll draft the contract-side language.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MA-Exec-Approval-Request.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeAI redlines — need deal desk + legal guidance + exec signoff for exceptions

Team — after reviewing Karthik’s assessment and considering the strategic value of EdgeAI as a reference in EU-focused media/health verticals, I approve a limited set of exceptions for this pilot with the following mandatory conditions:

1) Residency: Approve EU-only hosting (Frankfurt) for all processing and storage. Customer must confirm that no KMS keys required for operation are located outside EU; if customer requires a non-EU KMS we must document and escalate.

2) Audit: Approve a constrained audit scope: one (1) remote audit session during the pilot (screen share + targeted queries) and automated log exports (security telemetry and metadata only). No raw user payloads, no access to source, no on-site visits during pilot. Any on-site or expanded access requires our Exec-level approval and a signed NDA/addendum.

3) Discount: Approve a one-time 25% pilot discount, capped to the 3-month pilot and limited to the SOW value only. Renewals/production pricing revert to list. Finance should apply a one-off discount code and note the approval in HubSpot.

4) Data lifecycle: Add a contractual clause requiring deletion of customer data within 30 days of pilot termination unless otherwise agreed.

5) Indemnity/limits: Maintain our standard liability cap and add a carveout only where required by applicable law; do not expand liability beyond our standard MSA.

Rafael — please confirm with EdgeAI that they accept the constrained audit language and the 25% pilot discount. Once they send a signed acknowledgment, route the final SOW to DocuSign using the link in related_links and attach Exec-Approval-Memo.pdf (attached). I’ll copy Legal on the sign-off email.

Approved by: Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
